goals: Verify that the book deletion API endpoint returns a 200 status for successful deletions or a 404 status if the book is not found.
activities: Send an HTTP GET request to search for the book by title.
Check if the book search request was successful (status 200).
Parse the JSON response body from the successful search request.
Extract the ISBN from the parsed response.
Send an HTTP DELETE request to remove the book using the extracted ISBN (if available).
Verify the DELETE request's response status is either 200 or 404.
